chapter.heading: BOOK ONE: Psalms 1—41The Way of the Righteous and the End of the Ungodly
chapter.v:
But his
delight is in the law of the Lord,And in His law he meditates day and night.

He shall
be like a treePlanted by the rivers of water,That brings forth its fruit in its season,Whose leaf also shall not wither;And whatever he does shall prosper. [1 Chr. 29:1]

The ungodly
are not so,But are like the chaff which the wind drives away. [1 Chr. 28:9; Eph. 6:4 d Prov.]

Therefore the
ungodly shall not stand in the judgment,Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous. [Prov. 2:2,]

For the
Lord knows the way of the righteous,But the way of the ungodly shall perish. [2 Thess. 2:10]
